lints.name: auth_rls_initplan
lints.title: Auth RLS Initialization Plan
lints.description: Detects if calls to \`current_setting()\` and \`auth.<function>()\` in RLS policies are being unnecessarily re-evaluated for each row
lints.detail: Table \`public.profiles\` has a row level security policy \`profiles_insert_own\` that re-evaluates current_setting() or auth.<function>() for each row. This produces suboptimal query performance at scale. Resolve the issue by replacing \`auth.<function>()\` with \`(select auth.<function>())\`. See [docs](https://supabase.com/docs/guides/database/postgres/row-level-security#call-functions-with-select) for more info.

lints.detail: Table \`public.order_status_history\` has multiple permissive policies for role \`authenticated\` for action \`SELECT\`. Policies include \`{order_status_history_admin_select,order_status_history_owner}\`
